_readme: The full bibliography behind a series or shared world, for the Map tab's series map: every volume, whether or not it is on the shelf, read or held by a library; how the series connect; and the story order where it differs from publication order. book-series.json says which shelf candidates form one entry; this file says what the whole world contains, and a series without a record here is drawn from book-series.json alone. A world's `lines` use book-series.json ids where one exists; a line with `standalone: true` holds standalone novels and is drawn without a next-volume link. A book reaches the shelf through `key` (book-cache.json), `read` (a books-read.md row title; a row logged as #1-4 covers four books) or `rejected` (a book-rejects.jsonl entity). `n` is the Czech edition's number, `year` the original publication. `lib` + `recordUrl` is a verified print holding; when the world has `libChecked`, a book without one is not held in print at Valašské Meziříčí (Rožnov was not checked). Link kinds: `then` (`to` happens after `from` in the story), `prequel` (`from` is set before `to` but was written after it), `crossover` (characters of the line `to` appear in `from`). `story` lists the books in story order. Validate with `python tools/worlds.py check`.
